liner.body_md:
## What listeners single out

- **Mission in the Rain** (3 reviews, 1 other source): Reviewer stresses that the band played Mission in the Rain only five times, making it a rarity; Mission in the Rain is called pure bliss by this reviewer [13][17][18][24]
- **Cosmic Charlie** (3 reviews): Reviewer's favorite track: easy touch from Garcia, and Donna sings reasonably on key and sounds good; Reviewer notes this song does not flow into Let It Grow [10][11][18]
- **Candyman** (2 reviews): Garcia's lead floats through the song gently, like a soft breeze; Reviewer gushes about Garcia's guitar line in Candyman, describing it as a mind-bending, gooey psychedelic experience [10][19]
- **Franklin's Tower** (1 review): Reviewer loves the Help>Slip>Franklin's sequence, especially the hot guitar solos in Franklin's Tower [9]
- **Stella Blue** (1 review): Stella Blue is described as somewhat shaky [11]

## The recordings

- **gd76-06-04.aud.vernon.8034.sbeok.shnf** (recommended): audience recording; 28 songs; 175 min; rated 3/5 by 1 [1]. Said about its sound: Audience recording is hard to equalize and difficult to make listenable; rated poor [16]
- **gd1976-06-04.153709.sbd.martin.smith.clugston.flac1648**: soundboard; 24 songs; 182 min; rated 5/5 by 1 [2]. Said about its sound: Short patches from the Sony ECM280 source fill gaps in Might As Well and Dancing in the Streets [2]
- **gd76-06-04.sbd.cotsman.9797.sbeok.shnf**: soundboard; 24 songs; 181 min; rated 3.82/5 by 17 [5]. Said about its sound: Soundboard copy sounds hardly better than the reviewer's twenty-year-old multi-generation tape; a clearer version is wanted; Sound quality varies a lot, though the patching between sources is well done; Reviewer says better copies of this show circulate than this one [9][11][14][18]
- **gd1976-06-04.aud.berger.99872.flac16**: audience recording; 24 songs; 181 min; rated 4.25/5 by 4 [6]
- **gd1976-06-04.143136.partial.cm.sbd.miller.flac1644**: soundboard; 10 songs; 88 min [8]. Said about its sound: Partial soundboard set; the start of Promised Land and the end of Might As Well are cut [8]

## Around the show

- Reviewer calls this one of the best shows of 1976 [14]

## Tapers and lineage

- **gd76-06-04.aud.vernon.8034.sbeok.shnf**: source: unknown aud > ? > DAT [1]. Also: Unknown audience source to unknown steps to DAT, passed along via Dale Shepherd, seeded to etree by Matt Vernon [1]
- **gd1976-06-04.153709.sbd.martin.smith.clugston.flac1648**: taped by Steve Martin; transferred by Matt Smith, Scott Clugston; source: Mickey Hart's Master Soundboard Cassettes w/dolby B (Sony TC-152SD) > Steve Martin's 1st generation reels @ 3 3/4 ips [2]. Also: Reinhard Hohlwein and MOTB folks supplied a Sony ECM280 source covering Mission in the Rain, Looks Like Rain and Help On the Way [2]
- **gd76-06-04.sbd.cotsman.9797.sbeok.shnf**: source: Soundboard [5]
- **gd1976-06-04.aud.berger.99872.flac16**: transferred by Rob Berger; source: aud > mac - unknown equipment/taper [6]. Also: Audience recording; shn id 8034 supplies disc 3 tracks 2 and 3 [6]
- **gd1976-06-04.143136.partial.cm.sbd.miller.flac1644**: transferred by Charlie Miller; source: SBD > Cassette Master (Sony TC-152SD/Maxell UD) [8]

## Art and photos

- Poster by Play Dead: [Grateful Dead - 6-4-1976 Paramount Theatre Portland, OR](https://share.playdead.app/release/48010) [25]
